meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上后,收到 224×224 的 H&E 组织切片小图,Claude 会调用 DeepSpot-M 按基因名预测每个基因的空间表达量(log1p-CPM),按小图网格输出虚拟空间转录组结果;可查询约 19,000 个蛋白编码基因。
howto.when: 当用户需要约 20 倍下 224×224 小块的空间基因表达(log1p-CPM)、按基因符号查询蛋白编码基因,或想用 histolab 切块后预测整张切片时触发。

say.text: 用这张H&E切片预测EPCAM和CD3D在每块224×224小图里的表达。
say.note: 按基因名返回 log1p-CPM 表达值。

say.text: 把整张切片用histolab切成224×224小图,再预测约19k个基因。
say.note: 得到小图×基因的整张切片表达矩阵。

say.text: 将预测结果整理成AnnData对象,按坐标排成空间转录组。

howto.what_en: Given a 224×224 H&E tile, this skill calls DeepSpot-M to predict per-gene spatial expression (log1p-CPM), laid out on the tile grid as virtual spatial transcriptomics. About 19,000 protein-coding genes can be queried by symbol.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs spatial expression in log1p-CPM for 224×224 tiles at ~20x, queries protein-coding genes by symbol, or wants whole-slide prediction after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Use this H&E slide to predict EPCAM and CD3D expression in each 224×224 tile.
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values for the queried genes.

say_en.text: Tile the whole slide with histolab into 224×224 tiles, then predict about 19k genes.
say_en.note: Builds a tile-by-gene matrix for the whole slide.

say_en.text: Assemble the predictions into AnnData and lay them out by tile coordinates.
